aecho: Sends alerts to your other characters when you gain or lose certain buffs.
announcetarget: Announces special targets (such as Incursion adherents) to chat.
azuresets: Saves and loads Blue Magic spell sets.
battlemod: Condenses and recolors battle messages in the chat log.
bluealert: Alerts you when a monster uses Blue Magic you haven't learned.
blualert: Alerts you when a monster uses Blue Magic you haven't learned.
chatlink: Lets you open web links posted in chat.
consolebg: Adds a dark background behind the Windower console.
craft: Crafting helper that repeats synthesis for you.
debuffed: Shows the debuffs on your current target.
debuffing: Shows the debuffs you've applied, with timers.
distance: Shows the distance to your target in yalms.
distanceplus: Distance display that also shows spell and weapon skill range.
dressup: Changes how characters' gear looks on your screen (cosmetic only).
enemybar: Large health bar for your current target.
equipviewer: Shows your equipped gear as icons on screen.
findall: Searches items stored on all your characters.
gearinfo: Overlay for haste, Dual Wield needed and other gear and buff stats.
gearswap: Swaps gear automatically using your job Lua files.
homepoints: Travel between home points by typing the destination.
itemizer: Moves items between bags with //get and //put.
omen: Tracks Omen floor objectives and timers.
organizer: Packs and sorts gear between your bags and wardrobes.
pettp: Shows your pet's HP, MP and TP.
pointwatch: Tracks experience, capacity and limit points, and Dynamis time.
pouches: Uses a stack of items like pouches one after another.
react: Reacts to enemy moves for you, such as turning away from gaze attacks.
rolltracker: Shows Corsair roll results with lucky and unlucky numbers.
scoreboard: Shows party and alliance damage and DPS in real time.
shortcuts: Lets you type spells and abilities without exact formatting.
skillchains: Shows open skillchain windows and which weapon skills can follow.
speedchecker: Shows your current movement speed bonus.
spellbook: Finds spells you're missing by job and level.
spellcheck: Lists spells you haven't learned yet.
temps: Helps buy temporary items in Escha and Reisenjima.
tparty: Shows your target's HP percent and your party's TP.
treasury: Lots, passes and drops treasure pool items for you.
vanadielnexus: Connects the game to the Vana'diel Nexus app.
vwhl: Highlights notorious monster weaknesses (Voidwatch, Abyssea) in chat.
xipivot: Loads texture and map overlays without changing game files.
xivbar: HP, MP and TP bars in the style of FFXIV.
zonetimer: Shows how long you've been in the current zone.
plugin:binder: Lets Windower bind commands to keys.
plugin:config: Extra in-game graphics and client settings.
plugin:delaymenot: Removes artificial delays from menus and the macro bar.
plugin:ffxidb: Looks up items and monsters on FFXIDB.
plugin:infobar: Shows target and zone details in a bar.
plugin:luacore: Runs Lua addons. Required for every addon.
plugin:timers: Shows buff, debuff and recast timers.
